summary: Solo backcountry skier David Pickett-Heaps, 58, of Silverthorne, triggered a hard-slab avalanche on a northeast-facing slope in Boss Basin (upper Resolution Creek, south of Ptarmigan Pass) near Vail Pass; he had accessed the terrain by snowmobile from the Vail Pass Winter Recreation Area and was skiing alone. Reported overdue that evening; an overnight multi-agency search (SCRG thermal-imaging drone located the slide) ended at sunrise March 8 when Flight for Life dropped searchers and an avalanche dog found him buried with only a ski tip visible -- no signs of life. First avalanche fatality of the 2025-26 Colorado winter season (CAIC).
location: Boss Basin, upper Resolution Creek, south of Ptarmigan Pass (near Vail Pass)
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group, Vail Mountain Rescue Group, Summit County Sheriff's Office, Eagle County Sheriff's Office, Flight for Life Colorado
notes: Run 634 insert: date 2026-03-07 (Saturday) verified; CAIC final accident report 2026-03-13 (Next Summit summary) places the slide on the Eagle County side of Boss Basin.
